commit.message:
Add Outfit font and refactor star rendering

Add Outfit variable font files and LICENSE, register the font in global.css, and apply it to the site. Introduce a new About page and refactor star rendering: simplify Star.astro props/CSS, move positioning into parent containers, and replace older star utilities with a unified renderStar + setPosition flow in index.astro. Update layout and canvas (use Sky component, adjust canvas size), add hover labels as peer elements, and keep Panzoom initialization for viewport interactions.
